subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: A Great Fairy Fountain is located behind boulders near the Goron City entrance outside the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: You see the boulders here? A couple of them block the way to a Great Fairy Fountain.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem inside the Great Fairy Fountain doubles Link's magic power.

evidence.quote: Play the Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem and she'll appear to give you a magic bar enhancement. You now have twice the magic power!

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Smashing the red boulder near the Bomb Flower on Death Mountain Trail at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head to where the Bomb Flower was (the one you used in the Past to open Dodongo's Cavern) and you'll see a red boulder. Smash it with the hammer to reveal a Gold Skulltula....Remember that these two Gold Skulltulas don't appear unless it's night.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Smashing the boulder against the wall on Death Mountain Trail where falling rocks were in the past reveals a Gold Skulltula at night.

evidence.quote: at the place where the rocks fell down on you in the Past, smash the boulder that's against the wall to reveal another Gold Skulltula....Remember that these two Gold Skulltulas don't appear unless it's night.

subject: Biggoron
text: The giant Goron at the summit of Death Mountain gives Link a Prescription for eye treatment in exchange for the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: In exchange for the Broken Goron's Sword, (he'll fix it) he'll give you a PRESCRIPTION for eye treatment. Only then will he fix the sword.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located overhead above the fourth Silver Rupee in the first rupee room of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Right where the fourth Silver Rupee is, look up and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

subject: pot
text: Melt the red ice surrounding the pot using Blue Fire to obtain a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: melt the red ice surrounding the pot with Blue Fire. Inside the pot is a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: large chest
text: Melt the large block of red ice near the Blue Fire to reach a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Melt the larger block of red ice and open the large chest inside for the DUNGEON MAP of this Cavern.

subject: chest
text: Opening the chest behind the red ice to the right reveals the Compass.

evidence.quote: Melt the red ice to the right, and open the chest for this Cavern's COMPASS

subject: red ice
text: Melting the red ice to the left reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: melt the red ice to the left for a Piece of Heart.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located above the alcove where the Piece of Heart was found in Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Look above where you got the Piece to see a Gold Skulltula.

subject: White Wolfos
text: Defeating the White Wolfos in the shrine spawns a large chest containing the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: You'll encounter a White Wolfos....Once he's dead, a large chest will appear. Open it to get the IRON BOOTS.

subject: Sheik
text: Sheik appears after obtaining the Iron Boots and teaches Link the Serenade of Water.

evidence.quote: Sheik will appear and teach you the SERENADE OF WATER.

subject: King Zora
text: Thawing King Zora with Blue Fire rewards Link with the Zora Tunic, allowing him to breathe underwater.

evidence.quote: thaw out the Zora King with the Blue Fire....He'll thank you for reviving him, and will give you the ZORA TUNIC. This allows you to breathe underwater.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: Sink to the bottom of Zora's Fountain with the Iron Boots to collect a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Go back to the Fountain and use the Iron Boots to sink to the bottom. Find the Piece of Heart here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall to the left of the Diving Game platform in Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: Head to where the Diving Game was held, look out and to the left, and you'll see a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

subject: Eyeball Frog
text: The Eyeball Frog received from King Zora spoils in three minutes.

evidence.quote: Give the Prescription to the Zora King, and he'll give you a fresh EYEBALL FROG. It'll spoil in three minutes.

subject: Biggoron
text: After delivering the World's Greatest Eye Drops to Biggoron and waiting three days with the Claim Check, he presents the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: If you reach the place in time, the Biggoron will give you the CLAIM CHECK. After waiting three days, show him the Claim Check and he'll give you the BIGGORON'S SWORD.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: The Biggoron's Sword is carried with two hands, preventing Link from using a shield while wielding it.

evidence.quote: this is so heavy that Link has to carry it with both hands, so you can't shield with it.

subject: Secret Cave
text: Bombing the lone tree surrounded by a river opens a Secret Cave with a Piece of Heart at the bottom of the water.

evidence.quote: Go over to the area where trees are surrounded by a river. Plant a bomb at the lone tree to open a Secret Cave. Head inside, and put on the Iron Boots to sink to the bottom. You'll find a Piece of Heart!

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the crate at the bottom of the pool inside the Lakeside Laboratory reveals a Gold Skulltula that must be retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: sink to the bottom of the pool with the Iron Boots. Roll into the crate to reveal a Gold Skulltula. You can't use a sword underwater, so Hookshot it.

subject: Advanced Spin Slash
text: The Advanced Spin Slash is performed by holding B until the sword glows yellow and then releasing it.

evidence.quote: Advanced Spin Slash (Hold B until the sword is yellow, then release)

subject: large chest
text: Hitting the crystal switch near the water jet with an arrow lowers the jet and allows access to the chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: stand near the water jet, and hit the crystal with an Arrow. Open the large chest while the jet is down to get the COMPASS for this temple.

subject: large chest
text: Defeating all the Spikes in the room above Princess Ruto reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Defeat all the Spikes here to reveal a large chest. Open it for the DUNGEON MAP!

subject: torches
text: Standing behind the lit torch and shooting arrows through the flame lights the unlit torches and unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: stand behind the lit torch, and fire arrows through the fire to the unlit torches. Doing this will make the arrowheads catch on fire and light the torches. Once they're lit, head through the door.

subject: chest
text: Defeating the Shell Blades with the Hookshot when they open spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Kill the Shell Blades by Hookshotting them when they open, and a chest will appear. Open it to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: chest
text: Hookshotting past the Shell Blades leads to a chest at the surface containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Go past the Shell Blades carefully, and open the chest at the surface of the water for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Activating the crystal switch with the Advanced Spin Slash in the south hall room opens the gate guarding a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: use the Advanced Spin Slash to hit the crystal switch, opening the gate. There's a Gold Skulltula here.

subject: chest
text: Bombing the cracked wall on the east hall's bottom floor leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: rise to the surface to see a cracked wall. Bomb it, then open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: chest
text: Hookshotting the crystal in the central tower and defeating the underwater enemies unlocks a gate leading to a Small Key chest.

evidence.quote: Hookshot the crystal to release a horde of enemies, all which have to be killed with the Hookshot....Once all of them are gone, head to the surface of the water where the gate opened. Open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: water level puzzle
text: To cross the upper room, hit the crystal to raise the water, Hookshot across, hit the crystal to lower water, Hookshot, climb the statue, and cycle the crystal again.

evidence.quote: hit the crystal to raise the water. Hookshot across, then hit the crystal again to lower the water. Hookshot across, climb over the statue, and hit the crystal again. Hookshot across, hit the crystal, get on the statue, and hit the crystal again to get to the upper part of the room.

subject: Dark Link
text: Din's Fire is effective against Dark Link.

evidence.quote: Of course, you COULD use Din's Fire...

subject: Dark Link
text: Dark Link's health equals Link's total health, and each Master Sword blow depletes one full heart of his life.

evidence.quote: Dark Link has as much health as you do, and each Master Sword hit takes off a heart of Dark Link's health.

subject: Dark Link
text: Equipping the Iron Boots during the fight slows down Dark Link's movements.

evidence.quote: you can slow down Shadow Link's movements if you equip the Iron Boots.

subject: Dark Link
text: L- or Z-targeting Dark Link and executing a thrust attack with the Biggoron's Sword will hit him consistently.

evidence.quote: if you L(or Z)-target Dark Link and use the thrust attack with the Biggoron's Sword, it'll hit him every time.

subject: Dark Link
text: The Megaton Hammer can damage Dark Link effectively without requiring sword lockups.

evidence.quote: If you don't have the Biggoron's Sword and don't want to get the Giant's Knife, the Megaton Hammer works just as well on Shadow Link.

subject: Dark Link
text: A Deku Nut will stun Dark Link only once, after which he will dodge subsequent Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote: If you have Deku Nuts, use one to stun Dark Link, then go in for a slash. I've tried this, and it only works once, as afterwards he'll dodge your Deku Nuts to avoid getting stunned.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Right where the fourth Silver Rupee is, look up and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Right where the fourth Silver Rupee is, look up and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Dark Link
text: In order to defeat Dark Link, don't Z/L target him; if you target him you'll always endlessly clash swords, but don't target him and he'll have a harder time blocking your attacks.

evidence.quote: MINI-BOSS: Dark Link...in order to defeat him, DON'T Z/L TARGET HIM! If you do target him, you'll always endlessly clash swords...don't target him and he'll actually have a harder time blocking your attacks.
